cases.prompt: 为一个跨系统企业知识问答产品制作12页产品发布PPTX，受众是研发和运营负责人，需要有情绪起伏、产品截图、接入流程和试点数据。
expected: deck.big_idea/audience/desired_action non-empty
early energy dip and closing energy 5
at least 3 bleed modes including none
one flow with exactly one highlight
charts have action titles, highlight and source
lint 0 FAIL, inspect 0 ERROR, contact sheet reviewed

cases.prompt: 为一款桌面光环境硬件做10页图文PPTX。产品照片很多，数据很少；希望像编辑杂志，不要满篇卡片和科技蓝。
expected: paper theme or justified custom theme
image-led partial/edge/full rhythm
full plus color-block no more than 40 percent
no invented performance data
consistent image tone and crop focus
closing contains concrete CTA

cases.prompt: 为工业AI巡检方案制作14页汇报PPTX，包含准确率、误报率、发现时间和部署步骤。图表要遵循Storytelling with Data。
expected: no pie/donut/3D/dual-axis charts
bar axes start at zero
one or two highlights per chart
direct labels and sources
no more than two consecutive chart pages
a breather page between evidence clusters

cases.prompt: 我只有产品概念和三条功能，没有图片也没有真实数据。先帮我做一份8页PPTX。
expected: asks only direction-critical questions
uses color-block or typography before generic stock
marks synthetic images as placeholders
does not fabricate customer quotes or KPIs
delivery includes replacement list

cases.prompt: 明天内部演示，快速做5页简单产品更新PPTX，不要图表。
expected: uses fast track only because all conditions match
still creates brief/spec and runs lint/build/render/inspect
keeps a visible energy change
does not skip visual QA
